newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fire at Berlin town hall visited by Kennedy.
newsitem.headline: Fire at Berlin town hall visited by Kennedy.

text.p: The Berlin town hall where the late U.S. president John F. Kennedy made his famous "Ich bin ein Berliner" speech was damaged by fire on Wednesday.
More than 80 firefighters put out the blaze, which the fire brigade said had probably been caused by electrical appliances in the cellar.

The Schoeneberg town hall was the headquarters of the city administration in pre-unification West Berlin, when Kennedy visited in 1963 with his message of solidarity to the capitalist enclave marooned inside communist east Germany.
The building has now reverted to its original status as the seat of the district administration of Schoeneberg, an area of Berlin.
